mechanism_description: SEFRS v1.0은 KR retail-crowded inverse/leverage ETF 3종 (KODEX 200선물인버스2X = 252670, KODEX 인버스 = 114800, KODEX 레버리지 = 122630)의 일별 설정/환매 (Δ발행주식수 × NAV) notional flow를 multiplier-weighted aggregate 후 rolling z-score 60d로 표준화하여 KOSPI200 regime sentiment proxy를 생성한다. 핵심 paradigm: (1) 3 ETF complex aggregation — 단일 ETF flow noise 회피 + leverage 표준화 multiplier (252670=+2, 114800=+1, 122630=-2). (2) PIT-safe — flow = Δshares × NAV_{t-2} 가격효과 자동 제거 + t-2 strict lag. (3) Non-linear regime sensor — 중간 imbalance = risk-off continuation, extreme imbalance = contrarian (KR 99.9% retail loss + KOSPI 8000 + 34조 inverse inflow empirical 입증). (4) 12 features (1 primary + 8 secondary + 3 interaction) DPL-RC p_bad_1715 classifier feature pool inject (80 → 88) AUC uplift target ≥ 0.01. 학술 backbone: Brown-Davies-Ringgenberg 2021 RFS (ETF Arbitrage Non-Fundamental Demand) + Ben-David-Franzoni-Moussawi 2018 JF (ETFs Volatility) + Israeli-Lee-Sridharan 2017 RAS (Dark Side ETFs) + Pan-Zeng 2017 (AP Liquidity Mismatch) + Easley-Michayluk-O'Hara-Putnins 2021 RoF (Active Passive). Alpha sleeve X (AX-005/007 회피), regime feature only inject DPL-RC.
expected_role_explicit: DPL-RC v1.0 p_bad_1715 classifier (WT-D20260517_003) feature pool 80 → 88 uplift contribution. SEFRS 자체는 alpha sleeve X — multi-sleeve framework (1715 alpha + DPL-RC complement + SEFRS regime feature) 정합. AX-005 (KR defense single-signal long-only 실패) + AX-007 (single sleeve top20 mechanism break) 회피 mandate.
